changelog:
## What's new in 0.6.5-beta.1
- Stardew Valley: launch your companion onto your farm as a visible helper who walks, works, fights, and talks beside you (Play together > Stardew Valley; Sei installs SMAPI and its helper mod for you)
- Don't Starve Together: launch your companion into your hosted world as a survivor she picks for herself (Play together > Don't Starve Together; one companion per world)
- Game support files download on first launch instead of shipping in the installer, Minecraft included, so the app is about a third smaller
- Settings has one Games group for Minecraft, Stardew Valley, and Don't Starve Together
- Minecraft: pick the version for the Sei profile in the setup list; one "Sei <version>" profile per version, so an old world and a new one can coexist
- Each game's dashboard now looks like that game's HUD: parchment and vitals badges for Don't Starve, the wooden menu frame for Stardew
- Companions can look things up: search the web and read pages from chat, on calls, and in every game, and say so before they look; game companions ask their own wiki first
- Card image: regenerate a companion's portrait up to 3 times and switch between up to 8 saved versions
- Includes every fix from 0.6.1 through 0.6.4 (Ollama and local mode, local voices, the China mirror, the updater)

## What's new in 0.6.4
- Companions can look things up: search the web and read pages from chat, on calls, and in Minecraft, and say so before they look
- Settings has a Search group: use the free automatic lookup or your own Brave, Tavily, or Serper key
- Card image: regenerate a companion's portrait up to 3 times and switch between up to 8 saved versions
- Minecraft: the setup wizard now installs the Sei profile for the newest supported version
- Fixed: Ollama companions failed to start when summoned
- Fixed: signing in with a Google account that had never used Sei landed you with no name; onboarding now asks again
- Fixed: a lookup the companion announced on a call now runs and gets answered
- Fixed: a companion's saved portrait versions no longer show up broken on a second computer

## What's new in 0.6.3
- Fixed: Ollama models that think before answering (Qwen 3, DeepSeek R1, Gemma 4) went quiet in chat and on calls. Sei now asks them to answer directly, and gives slow local machines more time
- Fixed: small local models could repeat themselves on a call until they were cut off. Repeated lines are dropped and spoken replies from local models stay short
- Ollama no longer asks for an API key in Settings, onboarding, or the own-key screen

## What's new in 0.6.2
- Fixed: local voices could not speak in the installed app. Calls said "local speech cannot run on this install" even with a voice pack downloaded. They work now
- Local voices: the Pitch slider in Edit companion has a play button, so you can hear the companion's local voice at the pitch you set
- Fixed: portrait fitting and in-game item icons in the installed app

## What's new in 0.6.1
- Local mode grew up: run Sei fully on your own API key, with a dozen providers to pick from (Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, Ollama and more). Ollama needs no key at all
- Onboarding can now set up local mode end to end: pick a model, test the connection, and choose how companions hear you and speak
- Local voices that run on your device and work offline: an English pack and a Chinese pack, each with a female and a male voice
- SenseVoice on-device speech recognition, strongest for Chinese
- A missing voice pack no longer means a silent call: an installed voice steps in and a notice names the download that would fit better
- Speech recognition no longer drifts English into Chinese, and transcripts stop SHOUTING IN ALL CAPS
- The whole app speaks Chinese now, and picks it automatically on first launch
- Downloads and updates come from a mirror that works in mainland China
- On a Mac, closing the app with an update waiting now installs it, no restart button needed
- Newer Minecraft versions are supported, and Sei says clearly when a version is too new
- Blank character avatars heal themselves
- Buttons that cannot be used right now say why, instead of just being grey
notes: Your companion can join you in Stardew Valley and Don't Starve Together.
